latest_release.name: Clash Verge Rev v2.5.10
latest_release.body:
## v2.5.10
🐞 修复问题 - 修复全局模式缺少 `GLOBAL` 策略组，无法单独选择全局出口 - 修复服务模式下，SSH 节点的 `private-key` 使用私钥文件时内核无法启动 - 修复服务模式下，内核更新的 GEO 数据库不会同步回应用目录，导致使用新分类的规则无法通过校验 - 修复订阅的 DNS 配置变化后，「DNS 覆写」实际已关闭但开关仍显示开启且没有提示 **🖥️ Windows** - Windows：修复安装程序重新安装或覆盖时未提示退出运行中应用，导致卸载报错或覆盖失败
✨ 新增功能
🚀 优化改进
## 下载地址 ### Windows (不再支持Win7) #### 正常版本(推荐) - [64位(常用)](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_x64-setup.exe) | [ARM64(不常用)](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_arm64-setup.exe) #### 内置Webview2版(体积较大，仅在企业版系统或无法安装webview2时使用) - [64位](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_x64_fixed_webview2-setup.exe) | [ARM64](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_arm64_fixed_webview2-setup.exe) ### macOS - [Apple M芯片](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_aarch64.dmg) | [Intel芯片](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_x64.dmg) ### Linux #### DEB包(Debian系) 使用 apt ./路径 安装 - [64位](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_amd64.deb) | [ARM64](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_arm64.deb) | [ARMv7](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge_2.5.10_armhf.deb) #### RPM包(Redhat系) 使用 dnf ./路径 安装 - [64位](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge-2.5.10-1.x86_64.rpm) | [ARM64](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge-2.5.10-1.aarch64.rpm) | [ARMv7](https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases/download/v2.5.10/Clash.Verge-2.5.10-1.armhfp.rpm) ### FAQ - [常见问题](https://clash-verge-rev.github.io/faq/windows.html) ### 稳定机场VPN推荐 - [狗狗加速](https://cvr.dginv.click/#/register?code=oaxsAGo6) Created at Tue Nov 3 18:04:20 CST 2026.
